title: What time is it?
subtitle: Lucas is late (again) — telling the time, at / on / in
canDo: I can ask and say the time.
I can use at, on and in with times and days.
teacherNotes: Saati iki yolla öğretin: seven thirty (dijital, ABD'de çok yaygın) ve half past seven. İkisini de tanısınlar, birini üretsinler yeter.
"quarter to / past" mantığını ekranda bir saat çizerek gösterin; Türkçedeki "yediyi çeyrek geçiyor / sekize çeyrek var" ile aynı.
at / on / in: Türkçe ve Arapçada tek ek / edat var (-de, في). Üç kutulu tabloyu tahtada tutun.
Oyun: Öğretmen bir saat söyler, öğrenciler parmakla / yazarak gösterir.

sections.title: Warm-up
prompts: What time is your English class?

sections.title: Telling the time
sections.instructions: Listen and repeat. You can say the time in two ways.

support.ar: استمع وكرّر. يمكنك قول الوقت بطريقتين.

sections.title: Listen and read
sections.heading: Late again
sections.scene: Tuesday morning. Lucas runs into Sam's café.

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: Sam, what time is it? My phone is dead.

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: Ten to nine? Oh no! Class starts at nine on Tuesdays!

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Relax. The school is five minutes from here. Here's your coffee. Go, go!

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Good morning, Lucas. It's quarter past nine!

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: Sorry, Maya. My phone is dead, and my watch is at home.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Every Tuesday, Lucas! Here — a present for you.

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: A clock? Ha ha. Thank you, Maya!

support.tr: Tekrar oku. Doğru mu, yanlış mı?
support.ar: اقرأ مرة أخرى. صح أم خطأ؟

items.statement: At the café, it's ten past nine.
On Tuesdays, class starts at nine.

sections.title: Grammar: at, on, in
rules: **at** + clock time: at 7:30, at noon, at night
**in** + part of the day: in the morning, in the evening (but: **at** night)
What time is it? — It's seven o'clock. / It's half past seven. / It's seven thirty.
examples: I drink coffee in the morning.

support.tr: Saat için at (saat 7'de = at 7), gün için on (pazartesi günü = on Monday), günün bölümleri için in (sabahleyin = in the morning) kullanılır. Türkçedeki -de / -da ekinin karşılığı üç farklı kelimedir. İstisna: at night (geceleyin).
support.ar: نستخدم at مع الساعة (at 7 = في السابعة)، و on مع الأيام (on Monday = يوم الاثنين)، و in مع أجزاء اليوم (in the morning = في الصباح). في العربية نقول «في» في أغلب الحالات، أما في الإنجليزية فهناك ثلاث كلمات. والاستثناء: at night (في الليل).

tr.note: Türkçedeki -de her yerde aynı, İngilizcede değil. Saatten önce in, günden önce at kullanma.
